FOREWORD
( First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian February 1981, after the draft finalized by the Jute Machinery Spare Parts Sectional Comby the Textile Division Council.

0. 0.1 This Indian Standard Standards Institution on 5 Jute Mill Accessories and mittee had been approved

0.2 High speed jute bobbin consists of a top flange, a shank and a bottom flange. The top flange is generally made of plastics or vulcanized 6bre or a combination of the two. The shank of the bobbin is generally manufactured from good quality timber. Often this wooden shank is covered either on the outside or on the inside or on both the The bottom flange of the bobbin is usually sides with aluminium tube. made from good quality timber or a ply combination of vulcanized 6bre and plastics. 0.3 This standard was originally published in 1965. In this revision, bobbins of sizes 165 mm lift X 76 mm flange diameter ( used on 108 mmpitch apron-draft spinning frame with Baxter flyer ) and 145 mm lift X 76 mm flange diameter ( used on 108 mm pitchslip-draft spinning frame with Baxter flyer ) have been added. 0.4 To familiarize the units, the recommended in Appendix B. 0.4.1 The Standards use of SI units. industry with the International System ( SI ) SI ,units for use in the textile industry are given of Weights and Measures Act, 1976 also stipulates

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirementofthis or calculated standard is complied with, the final value, observed shall be rounded off i: expressing the resuit of a test or analysis, accordance with IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. *Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). 3

IS : 3189 - 1981 1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard prescribes requirements for four sizes of high-speed jute bobbins used on jute spinning frames of pitches 140 and 108 mm. 2. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS

2.1 Material - The shank and flanges of bobbins shall be made of Timber, whenever used materials as specified in the contract or order. in the manufacture of shanks or flanges, should be of good quality and It may be of any of the species listed in Appendix A. well-seasoned.

3.5 Thickness and Length of Alnminium Bush or Tube - The thickness of aluminium bush or tube if used shall be not less than Where aluminium bushes are required to be used, the length 0.75 mm. of the bush shall be not less than 25 mm at the top and 28 mm at the bottom of the bobbin. The length of the outside aluminium tube shall be not less than the nominal bobbin lift.

IS : 3189 - 1981 3.6 Method of Test bobbins shall be checked flat surface. 4. PACKING AND The dimensions and by the use of suitable concentricity of the calipers, gauges and a

MARKING be marked with the name/trade-mark of the

4.1 Each bobbin manufacturer.

shall

4.2 Each bobbin marked as in 4.1 should be wrapped in polyethylene film. An agreed number of such bobbins shall be packed in gunny bags for local delivery and in wooden cases for outstation delivery. 4.3 Each bag/wooden case shall be marked with the following:

a) Name of the material, b) Size of the bobbins as ` lift ( mm ) x bottom flange dia ( mm ) `, c) Pitch ( mm ) and drafting system of the spinning frame for which the bobbin is suitable, d) Gross and net mass, e) Number of bobbins contained in it,

f ) Name/trade-mark of the manufacturer, and g) Any other information desired by purchaser. 4.4 The bobbins may also be marked with the IS1 Certification Mark.

NOTE - The use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks ) Act and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The IS1 Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements. of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by IS1 and operated by the producer. IS1 marked products are also continuously checked by IS1 for conformity Details of conditions, under which a licenec to that standard as a further safeguard. for the use of the IS1 Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.
